name: Deliver to MacKinley
label: Quest
description: Stoley hands you a bottle of Steamwheedle bilge rum for MacKinley, the "Sea Wolf" of Booty Bay, to put an end to MacKinley's beliefs about Booty Bay booze.
intro: Stoley hands you a bottle of Steamwheedle bilge rum for MacKinley, the "Sea Wolf" of Booty Bay, to put an end to MacKinley's beliefs about Booty Bay booze.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thanks again for your help, friend. Here's a bottle of Steamwheedle bilge rum. Take it to MacKinley and he can finally put to rest his crazy beliefs about Booty Bay booze.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did Stoley cough up my booze?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can't believe it! This stuff is... Terrible! That's great!
Well I guess Stoley can keep the money he owes me. He's true to his word about Steamwheedle bilge rum. That stuff is as thick as gravel and burns like lava!
